patterns.note: Project showcase sections feature dynamic, overlapping image collages that break from a strict grid, creating a visually rich and editorial feel.
A single clean sans-serif typeface is used consistently, with large, bold headings for impact and smaller, lighter weights for body text and subtle labels.

The site employs a high-contrast dark mode (black backgrounds with white text) for key sections and transitions, alternating with a clean light mode (white backgrounds with dark text) for content areas.
A full-screen, complex lottie animation appears as a dramatic visual interlude immediately after the hero video on initial scroll, before the main content sections are revealed.
Content sections and individual project elements reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth scroll experience.
Client logos are presented in a dense, multi-column grid on a light background, providing social proof in a clean, organized manner.

technique_notes: The initial hero section features a full-width video that plays automatically. Upon scrolling, this hero transitions to a full-screen black background with a large, white, animated lottie graphic that acts as a visual separator and engaging interlude.
The main navigation bar is sticky, initially transparent over the hero, and then adopts a solid dark background with white text as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections throughout the site are revealed with a subtle, staggered fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the user's viewport, enhancing engagement without being distracting.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous line height, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and very small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for most elements and images, with subtle rounding for interactive elements like buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with ample vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of openness, while project image collages have tighter, more dynamic spacing.

standout: The most distinctive element is the dramatic full-screen Lottie animation that appears as a scroll-triggered transition after the hero video, serving as a captivating visual interlude. This, combined with the dynamic, overlapping image layouts in project showcases, gives the site a highly artistic and editorial feel that goes beyond typical portfolio sites.
